year_attribution: Whole holding interval exit year, not exact calendar-year marked PnL; annual views do not reset holdings.
drawdown_basis: Weekly-marked synthetic account starting at USD 100000; annual views rebase.
annualization: 52 times mean weekly fixed-notional PnL return; not CAGR.

bootstrap.interpretation: conditional descriptive interval, not a prospective test

provenance.provider: Yahoo Finance public chart endpoint, unofficial API
provenance.calendar_check: All symbols match SPY; no independent exchange-calendar audit
provenance.price_convention: Open times adjusted-close/close; a total-return proxy, not an executable price
